== Page created (27 October 2026) ==

=== Build notes ===
* Stub created from the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet, which lists "Bob Madison, Will Madison" as two separate playtesters ([https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet] (1995), credits page ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Preserved copy])).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The fan anagram list gives "[Bob/Will] Madison" for [[Imperial Trooper Guard Dainsom]] and does not say which Madison is meant. See [[Talk:Bob Madison]].
* [[Sandy Wible|Will Wible]] is a redirect to [[Sandy Wible]], a different playtester on the same list; it is not this Will.
